# changlabtw — Bioinformatic Data Science Lab, NCCU

> GitHub Pages namespace of the Bioinformatic Data Science Lab at National Chengchi University (NCCU), Taipei, Taiwan, led by Jia-Ming Chang (張家銘), ORCID 0000-0002-6711-1739. The lab website lives at /lab/; other paths under this domain are documentation sites for individual software tools.

## Lab website

- [Lab website](https://changlabtw.github.io/lab/): research, publications, team, software
- [llms.txt](https://changlabtw.github.io/lab/llms.txt): concise description of the lab and its principal investigator, with verified profiles
- [llms-full.txt](https://changlabtw.github.io/lab/llms-full.txt): full text of the lab website

## Elsewhere

- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/changlabtw): source code of the lab's tools
- [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6711-1739): authoritative identifier for Jia-Ming Chang
